      "snippet": "Yes — that is exactly what we were doing.
Here is the precise intent, without any MetaBlooms ceremony layered on top:
What the Termux work was for
We were using Termux as a deterministic acquisition environment to:

Download multiple GitHub repositories

Preferably as ZIP archives (not git clone)

Branch-aware (resolve default branch instead of assuming main)

Make them ingestible

Upload-safe (size-aware, split when needed)

Lossless with receipts (hashes, index JSON)

Prepare them for MetaBloo"
